title: CITE-seq PBMC physical antibody surface-protein FACS ground truth with cryptographic blinding and ECE calibration
claim_target: Cell annotation evidence evaluated against physical antibody surface-protein FACS ground truth achieves SUPPORTED tier precision >= 90% and Expected Calibration Error <= 0.08 under cryptographic blinding.
claim_exclusions: rare novel lineage discovery without custom reference markers
continuous developmental trajectory discretizations without pseudotime warrant

locked_endpoints.supported_tier_precision: SUPPORTED tier precision on physically gated cells must be >= 0.90
locked_endpoints.cryptographic_blinding: cryptographic blinding key SHA-256 must match pre-lock attestation
